An '''attack''' on the [[Vinsoth system/Legends|Vinsoth system]] was made in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|intergalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong empire]] whom where [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invading]] [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at the time. The [[Yuuzhan Vong]] attack the system after a previous [[Attack on the Ciutric system|attack]] on the [[Ciutric system/Legends|Ciutric system]], and after attacking the Vinsoth system proceeded to split their forces and attack a large number of other [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]. A portion of Vong forces traveled to and [[Battle of New Holgha|attacked]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[New Holgha]], while another portion traveled to and [[Attack on the Vandyne system|attacked]] the [[Vandyne system/Legends|Vandyne system]] via the [[Axxila system/Legends|Axxila system]]. A third group traveled to the [[Botajef system/Legends|Botajef system]] and then split to [[Attack on the Bandomeer system|attack]] the [[Bandomeer system/Legends|Bandomeer system]] via the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] and [[Attack on the Columex system|attack]] the [[Columex system/Legends|Columex system]] via the [[Salin Corridor/Legends|Salin Corridor]].<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The attack on the Vinsoth system was first shown in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a sourcebook released in [[2009]] and written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]]. The Atlas included the attack in a map titled "Vector Prime and the Yuuzhan Vong advance" which showed the movements and conflicts of the various factions involved in the Yuuzhan Vong War, between 25 ABY and [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]]. The book gives no information on the outcome of the attack, but a separate map shows the Vinsoth system was under Vong control by [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]].<ref name="EA" />
